title: Israeli Drone Strike Kills One, Wounds Civilians Including Children in Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis
detail: An Israeli drone strike hit a gathering of displaced Palestinians in the Al-Mawasi area west of Khan Younis on September 11, 2026, killing one person and wounding at least nine to thirteen others, including children; the wounded were transferred to Nasser Medical Complex. Separately in Gaza City's Al-Daraj neighborhood, Mohammad Shamali died of wounds sustained in a strike the previous day, and an Israeli-occupation vehicle shot and wounded a Palestinian in the Al-Maghazi refugee camp. An Israeli tank also opened fire toward the Ard al-Limoun area of Al-Mawasi; casualties from that incident were unclear.

media.caption: Israeli attacks continue across Gaza, wounding civilians including children, Sep 11, 2026

title: Documentary Featuring 'Lavender' AI-Targeting Whistleblowers Premieres at Venice
detail: An Israeli-made documentary premiered at the Venice Film Festival on September 11, 2026, featuring 24 anonymous Israeli military and intelligence whistleblowers describing an AI-powered targeting system called 'Lavender' used to help identify strike targets in Gaza. Interviewees described systematic destruction of civilian homes and characterized remote operations as resembling 'a video game.' The IDF 'categorically rejected' the film's allegations, saying strike decisions 'were made by human personnel only… and not by artificial intelligence,' and questioned the anonymous interviewees' access to relevant information. Former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett called the film a 'blood libel.'
